serverInfo.name: yume-mcp
serverInfo.title: Yume
serverInfo.description: Real, read-only MCP server over Yume's product catalog, FAQ, and blog content — papelería y artículos personalizados desde Guadalajara, Jalisco, México.

tools.name: get_products

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full detail for one Yume product by slug: price, specs, description, and FAQ.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Search Yume's frequently asked questions across all products.

tools.name: get_blog_posts
tools.description: List Yume's blog posts — local commerce guides for Guadalajara/Jalisco.

tools.name: get_blog_post_detail
tools.description: Get the full content of one Yume blog post by slug.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Get a link to request a real quote from Yume via WhatsApp.
